rules: every version forecasts the same eligible games at the same T-60 information cutoff from the same L1 snapshot
each version writes its own immutable forecast package per game; a locked package is never rewritten; corrections are new package versions
a model version never changes after its card is written; learning from prospective outcomes creates a new version
no version's prospective results alter another version during the evaluation period
comparisons use only games every compared version forecast, per target and population, on the cumulative tables
attribution is reported stepwise: v0.2 - v0.1 = season awareness; v0.3 - v0.2 = availability; v0.4 - v0.3 = rotation / minutes + opportunity redistribution; never only the v0.4 score
PLANNED versions are refused by the executor until their card is FROZEN with hashes and a pinned commit

no version uses betting lines (game total, point spread, player props) or any market-derived quantity as an input; game pace, if ever wanted, is registered here as its own later step (its own version and card) before use

a challenger is judged only by its registered live_decision_rule, read at the pre-set checkpoints; the executor's comparison tables are computed continuously but no decision is taken between checkpoints and no version is retired or retuned on an interim reading

versions.lane: S0 (also run by X1 alongside every challenger)
versions.lineage: P1 ladder rung L2 = hoopslab.models.baselines.PlayerMean(half_life=5.0), mode A
versions.changes: none; must never be modified (no season reset, no injury information, no minutes model, no recalibration, h = 5, forecast population unchanged)
inputs: ELIGIBLE (4 states, derived one way from an L1 snapshot by hoopslab.pregame.contract.to_eligible_v01)

versions.changes: historical weighting only: weight = recency x season-transition x context-similarity with the grid point frozen by R1; same targets, pmf construction, dispersion fit, league fallback, cutoff
must_not_contain: tonight's availability beyond the ELIGIBLE states the baseline also receives
requires: research_season/01_carryover_spec.md frozen by a changelog row
card with implementation hash and pinned commit

live_decision_rule.primary_score: mean CRPS per target on STATUS_CONFIRMED units (docs/shadow/01 section 4) of games both versions forecast at the same information cutoff; secondary: log score, 80% coverage, PIT dispersion
live_decision_rule.minimum_data_before_first_reading: 60 NBA game days with both versions locked and scored and >= 3,000 scored STATUS_CONFIRMED units per target; further readings only at every additional 30 game days (checkpoints fixed in advance)
live_decision_rule.inference: paired block bootstrap over game days (hoopslab.metrics.compare.compare_losses, B = 2000, seed 12345), 95% CI, Holm over the seven targets (apply_decisions)
live_decision_rule.minimum_effect: CRPS skill 0.01 (relative to the compared version), the P1 ladder MPE (experiments/p1_ladder/config.json), on the core targets PTS, REB, AST, MIN
live_decision_rule.decision_labels: SUPPORTED / FALSIFIED / PROMISING per docs/prereg/08_metric_spec.md; a challenger is adopted as the new reference only when SUPPORTED on the core targets and not FALSIFIED on any target; the baseline keeps forecasting regardless
live_decision_rule.strata_reported: team game index <= 20 (the window v0.2 is built for) vs > 20; STATUS_EXPECTED and UNKNOWN populations; month
live_decision_rule.no_peeking: results reach Research Claude only as a Tray-logged O-shadow aggregate after a checkpoint

versions.lineage: SEASON-AWARE-SHADOW-v0.2 if R1 produced the artefact; otherwise L2-A-SHADOW-v0.1 directly (then v0.3 - v0.1 is the availability attribution and no season-awareness step exists)

requires: a frozen rule for how absent teammates enter (fixed before any prospective forecast)
